comment.comment:
Why I'm bullish on $MASK

Wall Street is coming to Hyperliquid. ICE just signed to bring Hyperliquid perps onshore, and tokenized stocks are flooding HyperCore. The problem: every order on Hyperliquid is public. No serious fund wants its strategy readable in real time.
Nullmask fixes that, with compliance built in. Deposits are screened before they enter the pool, so funds can stay private without touching dirty money. Private perps are next on the roadmap.

The team is legit. Founder Tomas Krnak's team built Zcash shielded transactions into Trezor on a Zcash Foundation grant, and their work was merged into Zcash itself. Doxxed and shipping.

The numbers: $50M+ private volume in weeks, #1 privacy protocol by revenue, real yield paid to holders in ZEC and MASK, and supply being burned. All at a ~$20M market cap while ZEC and NEAR trade in the billions.
